authority: #K2-377 sec.2.3 (the method edict): C35 = the product lacks a HARD WORK-DOMAIN BOUND; the fix is a thin wrapper that keeps the method and clamps both the rip and the re-route search to the frozen frame.
status: SPEC (the run is deferred by one turn ON PURPOSE - the ruling's own fail-closed ordering is preflight/conservation FIRST, then exactly one run; running without the bound would burn the authorised quota on a KNOWN-FAIL path)

wrapper_design.placement: one thin stage AFTER the product, inside regen.relocate_relative_c17v1 - the product itself is NOT re-derived (sec.20.4: the copied method stays)
mechanism: 1. compute the base (l14) copper OUTSIDE the frozen frame as a canonical multiset (block.outside_geometry(base, frame)) - already implemented and proven (the block chain's C6 = 0 came from exactly this quantisation: block.clip_iu + the dR-segment port predicate)
2. compute the same for the product's output
3. delete from the output every outside piece that is NOT in the base multiset (the 241 added pieces)

4. re-add every base outside piece that is missing from the output (the 9 removed pieces), with its net / layer / width, using the SAME IU-exact geometry (no re-computation of the endpoints - copy them)
5. leave the in-frame work untouched (that is the method's product)
wrapper_design.why_it_is_a_bound_and_not_a_judge_trick: the wrapper does not change any criterion: it makes the ENGINE respect 'work only inside the frame'. C6 stays as approved and is measured the same way.

expected_consequences_to_measure.C6: must become 0 by construction (unless a crossing piece's in-frame half was also changed - to be instrumented)
expected_consequences_to_measure.C1: MAY RISE - some of the product's long out-of-frame re-routes were how it closed gaps; restoring the old outside copper can re-open them
expected_consequences_to_measure.C2: MAY RISE - the restored outside copper can clash with the in-frame new copper

alternatives_considered_and_why_rejected.verdict: REFUTED by measurement (#K2-377 accepted ENG's R1016): 181 of the 241 added outside pieces lie >3mm out (max 84mm), so a search-window parameter cannot bound the work
NOT a bound - it is the current state

alternatives_considered_and_why_rejected.alt: re-lay everything inside the frame (the old block chain)
alternatives_considered_and_why_rejected.verdict: REJECTED - that was A-prime attempts 1-3: C1 40 / C2 564, i.e. the method the ruling told us to replace

prerequisite_before_the_run: conservation/capacity reading inside the frame (the routing demand vs the free space) - if it cannot be stated, STOP and do not burn the run
the judging must emit ALL NINE ECO rows (C1-C9) - C36 is implemented and regression-covered as of this commit
acceptance: A-prime's full table C1-C9 PASS, with C6 = 0 and the entry/gate/run-count evidence (entry command + C34 PASS + 1/1)
